Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety review. All checks ran locally. The trial merge with upstream main `f90e9dc8ecd32a17d5a0379ff7d52f040a3c9d69` was clean. The rules used for this review are from that main commit.

What looks good:

- The parser keeps the rotary chain order and reports invalid fields by name.
- The project test shows that the new machine fields survive save and load.
- The post tests show that the non-RTCP trunnion cannot use G43.4. The Doosan test also checks the rotary brake option.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:265` — Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. The full diff adds the Break-through control for Drill, Bore, and internal Thread. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:82` — Add structural UI tests for the new Break-through rows. The UI test edits only set `break_through: None` in existing fixtures. No UI test checks the new label, default value, or control. Check the Drill and Bore rows, and check that the Thread row is present for an internal thread and absent for an external thread. Check that an edit uses the command history and can be undone. Current main requires structural assertions for UI changes.
3. `crates/app/src/operation/break_through.rs:7` — Move the value-only helper and its unit tests to the crate that owns this domain work. This module uses only toolpath, geometry, units, and a tolerance. It does not read or write the ECS world, a project file, a command, MCP, or the CLI. Keep the setup data access in app and pass the values to the helper. This is required by current main's **app holds the document, nothing else** rule.

These three items are in changes inherited from #2126. They apply to the full diff against current main. They can be corrected in the parent PR before this PR is merged.

Local build and test results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Post test build (`--no-run`, selected targets) | Pass |
| App test build (`--no-run`, selected targets) | Pass |
| Post `trunnion_schema` | 4 passed |
| Post `doosan_dnm_post` | 9 passed |
| Post `fanuc_post` | 12 passed |
| App `trunnion_schema` | 2 passed |
| App `break_through` | 5 passed |
| App `index_swing` | 13 passed |
| App `index_swing_horizontal` | 13 passed |
| Motion library | 396 passed, 6 ignored |
| UI library, from `crates/ui` | 914 passed, 6 ignored |
| Clippy, all targets of post, app, motion, and UI, with `-D warnings` | Pass |

The quick gate plan was read with `--dry-run`. The selected checks above ran; the full quick gate did not run. No pixel snapshot tests ran.

I repeated two mutations in the local review worktree:

- Removed the chain-order sort. `rotary_chain_order_preserved_when_controller_coordinates_differ` failed with exit code 101:
  ```text
  assertion `left == right` failed: parent A must lead rotary chain
    left: String("C")
   right: "A"
  ```
- Replaced `doosan-dnm.cps` with its upstream main version. `explicit_non_rtcp_trunnion_does_not_promise_controller_compensation` failed with exit code 101:
  ```text
  doosan-dnm.cps must refuse non-RTCP multi-axis trunnion even with rotaryBrake:
  ```
  The output included `G00 X0. Y0. Z20. A30.` with no refusal.

Both mutations were restored. All 4 post schema tests then passed. The source tree matched the local trial merge after restoration.

No CL or NC golden files changed against current main. No snapshot PNGs changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Added before and after screenshots for Drill, Bore, and internal Thread to the PR body. The six images are on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots branch at 0017bf3c0. Each image link was checked.
2. Added three structural UI pins: drill_and_bore_break_through_rows_show_the_default_and_edit_control, thread_break_through_is_one_pitch_for_internal_and_absent_for_external, and break_through_edits_apply_through_command_history_and_undo. They check the labels, defaults, controls, external Thread absence, numeric edits, Apply, and undo. Removing the three rows made all three tests fail. Restoring the rows made all three pass.
3. Moved the value-only helper and its unit tests to camcraft-motion. App keeps the setup reads and passes the values and tolerance. The motion API pin caller_tolerance_controls_the_stock_bottom_warning fails without the motion export. It also fails when the helper ignores the supplied tolerance. Both restorations pass. The five app Break-through integration tests pass.

New head: f01c37805b4e1ec19d13620c6d49e86264827137.

Validation: cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passed post, motion, and app. The initial UI run and an isolated test run failed in the unrelated AI post-confirmation test. The error was Harness::run exceeded max_steps(4). The failed UI gate step then passed on the unchanged head. All selected gate steps have now passed. Clippy passed for motion, app, and UI, with all targets and -D warnings.

Please re-review this head.

This existing defect is tracked in #2170, with a fix in #2171. It is not a requested change for this PR.

Resolved merge conflicts with `upstream/main` (`4e0b9abef`) on PR #2162 (the latest review on `f01c37805` had `Requested before merge: none`). Marked the PR as draft before pushing.

Changes:
- Merged `upstream/main` into `issue/1962-trunnion-schema` (merge commit, no rebase).
- Preserved `upstream/main`'s `v64` (`#2015`) and `v65` (`#2133`) project barriers and bumped `PROJECT_VERSION` from `65` to `66` for `#1962` (`crates/app/src/project/file.rs`, `apply.rs`, `mod.rs`), updating `crates/app/tests/trunnion_schema.rs` (`PROJECT_VERSION >= 66`) and `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs` (`project::PROJECT_VERSION`).
- Took `upstream/main`'s merged `#2126` `camcraft_motion::break_through` helper, test, and `generate.rs` call (`judge(..., unit)` with internal `Z_TOL`), leaving `crates/motion` and `crates/app/src/operation` unchanged from `upstream/main`, and noted the refresh in `docs/decisions/1962-trunnion-schema.md`.

Tests:
- `camcraft-post`: `trunnion_schema` (4/4), `doosan_dnm_post` (9/9), `fanuc_post` (12/12).
- `camcraft-motion`: `break_through` (1/1) and 4 `break_through`/`thread_tests` lib tests.
- `camcraft-app`: `trunnion_schema` (2/2), `break_through` (7/7), `tilt_basis_compat` (5/5), `first_4axis_part` (4/4), `project_roundtrip` (73/73), `index_swing` (13/13), `index_swing_horizontal` (13/13).
- `camcraft-ui`: `holes_break_through` and `structural::break_through` (5/5).
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 252/252 steps passed (`0 failed`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed (0 warnings).

New head: f7620f75b09f8f4314997fb9108a3974570b41e2.

Please re-review this head.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:117` — Mark the project format change as breaking in the commit metadata. This change advances the format from v65 to v66. Older builds cannot open the new files. Current main's **Commits and Releases** rule requires `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for an incompatible project-file change. None of the PR commits has this marker. Add a new commit with a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer that describes the v66 format and the refusal by older readers. Keep the existing commit history. The release notes must identify this compatibility change.

The earlier requests are complete:

- The body has before and after screenshots for Drill, Bore, and internal Thread. I opened all six images.
- The structural tests check the Break-through controls, defaults, external Thread absence, Apply, and undo. They pass.
- The value-only helper is in motion. The app reads the setup and passes its values. The refresh keeps the helper from current main.

The parser preserves rotary chain order and scales pivot and offset lengths.
The project test preserves the new machine data through save and load.
The post tests check the explicit non-RTCP refusal, including the Doosan rotary brake option.

Addressed:

- Marked the v65 to v66 project format change in new commit 9b1c5ece608e2a43e423d8ca7f25916bfbb44add with a BREAKING CHANGE: footer. It explains the trunnion fields and explicit non-RTCP capability, and that v65 and older readers refuse v66 files. Existing commits are unchanged.
- Updated the PR's Changelog release-note text with the same breaking compatibility warning. The metadata pin `v66_breaking_metadata_and_release_note` passes. Removing the footer makes the pin fail; restoring it passes. The pin and mutation fixtures stayed outside the repository.
